maddeler.e:
أتهافت (form VI)
# أَتَهَافَتُ (ʔatahāfatu) /ʔa.ta.haː.fa.tu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَهَافَتَ (tahāfata)
# أَتَهَافَتَ (ʔatahāfata) /ʔa.ta.haː.fa.ta/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَهَافَتَ (tahāfata)
# أَتَهَافَتْ (ʔatahāfat) /ʔa.ta.haː.fat/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَهَافَتَ (tahāfata)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
